messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
To match the posting requirement ("Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience"), I need to know the exact number of years of backend engineering experience the candidate has. This detail is missing from the current summary. 

Not supplying the explicit number of years could lead to your application being filtered out or overlooked by recruiters and automated systems, as they often rely on stated requirements to assess candidate suitability.

Please provide the number of years of backend engineering experience.
